description: Position in the PEW tender pipeline (1-7). Blank = not selectable on Opportunity.
label: Pipeline Order
name: Sales Stage-pew_stage_order

description: The client's Task / Document Number, e.g. ABC123-PIP-001. The Subject is the Document Name.
label: Document Number
name: Task-pec_document_number

description: The PEC Scope this Task belongs to, for Project -> Scope -> Task traceability.
label: Scope
name: Task-scope

label: Document Category
name: File-document_category
options:
Tender / RFQ Document
Drawing
Technical Specification
Clarification / Query Response
Addendum / Corrigendum
Minutes of Meeting
Site Visit Note
Proposal
Pricing / BOQ
EMD / Bid Security
NDA
Work Order / PO
PQC / Verification Proof
Other Commercial

description: Set automatically when this Project is created from a won Opportunity. Cleared when a Projects Manager approves the Project via workflow.
label: Pending Review
name: Project-pending_review

description: Final negotiated contract value from the source Opportunity, in company currency.
label: Contract Value
name: Project-pew_contract_value

description: The end client / operating owner, where different from the billed Customer.
label: End User
name: Project-end_user

description: The client's possible answers to a submitted document. Every Task revision of this Project picks its Approval Code from this list.
label: Approval Codes
name: Project-pec_approval_codes

description: Decides which tender fields and approvals apply.
label: Inquiry Type
name: Opportunity-pew_inquiry_type
options:
Public / Govt Tender
Corporate / Private Tender
Direct Private Inquiry
Back-to-Back / Consortium Bid
Rate Contract / Call-Off Order

label: Application / Scope of Work
name: Opportunity-pew_application_scope
options:
Conceptual & Feasibility Studies
Multi-Disciplinary Detailed Engineering
Storage Tank Design & Engineering
Advanced Analysis & Simulation
Specialized Advisory & Brownfield
3D Modeling & Digital Solutions

label: Project Nature
name: Opportunity-pew_project_nature
options:
Greenfield (New Facility)
Revamp / Routine Maintenance
Third-Party Vetting / Document Review
Pure Advisory / Conceptual Study

depends_on: eval:doc.pew_stage_index>=2 && ["Public / Govt Tender", "Corporate / Private Tender", "Back-to-Back / Consortium Bid"].includes(doc.pew_inquiry_type)
label: Tender Details
name: Opportunity-pew_stage2_tender_section

label: Tender / Bid Ref No
mandatory_depends_on: eval:doc.pew_stage_index>=3 && ["Public / Govt Tender", "Corporate / Private Tender", "Back-to-Back / Consortium Bid"].includes(doc.pew_inquiry_type)
name: Opportunity-pew_tender_ref_no

label: Procurement Portal
name: Opportunity-pew_procurement_portal
options:
SAP Ariba
Coupa
Client Custom Portal
Email

description: The project owner; Inquiry From is the bidding partner.
label: End Client / Ultimate Owner
name: Opportunity-pew_end_client

label: Credential Sharing Mode
name: Opportunity-pew_credential_sharing
options:
Using our credentials
Using partner credentials

label: Due Date & Time
mandatory_depends_on: eval:doc.pew_stage_index>=4 && ["Public / Govt Tender", "Corporate / Private Tender", "Back-to-Back / Consortium Bid"].includes(doc.pew_inquiry_type)
name: Opportunity-pew_bid_submission_deadline

description: Sends the details above to management for a Bid Decision.
label: Request Bid Approval?
name: Opportunity-pew_request_bid_approval

depends_on: eval:doc.pew_stage_index>=2 && ["Public / Govt Tender", "Corporate / Private Tender", "Back-to-Back / Consortium Bid"].includes(doc.pew_inquiry_type) && doc.pew_request_bid_approval
label: Management Decision
name: Opportunity-pew_stage2_approval_section

description: Declined / No-Bid offers to declare the Opportunity Lost.
label: Bid Decision (Go / No-Go)
name: Opportunity-pew_bid_decision
options:
Pending
Approved to Bid
Declined / No-Bid

description: Internal target to finalize the submission.
label: Bid Target Date
name: Opportunity-pew_bid_target_date

description: Choosing No-Go offers to declare the Opportunity Lost.
label: Go / No-Go Decision
name: Opportunity-pew_go_no_go

description: Commercial document. Never copied to the Project.
label: Final Proposal
name: Opportunity-pew_final_proposal

label: Sub-Stage Status
name: Opportunity-pew_evaluation_substage
options:
Technical Bid Review
Price Bid Review
Commercial Negotiation

description: Check this box once the client has formally issued an LOI or PO.
label: Client has issued a formal LOI or PO
name: Opportunity-client_has_issued_loi_or_po

description: Visible to Sales Managers only. Stays on the Opportunity; upload as a private file.
label: Work Order / Client PO
name: Opportunity-pew_work_order_file
